skill.title: Quadrants
skill.promise: You can name the quadrant of a point.
skill.pipAbility: Pip knows which side of the plane it is on.

lessons.title: Name the side

screens.prompt: x is positive and y is positive. Where is the point?

feedback.wrong_option: Positive x is right. Positive y is up. That corner is the upper right.

screens.correctMessage: Both positive means the upper right.

screens.prompt: x is negative and y is positive. Where is the point?

feedback.wrong_option: Negative x is left. Positive y is still up.

screens.correctMessage: Left and up is the upper left.

screens.prompt: A point in the upper left has negative x. Set x.

feedback.too_low: That x is farther left than this point. Move toward zero.
feedback.too_high: The upper left stays negative. Move left of zero.

screens.correctMessage: Negative x sits left of the origin.

screens.prompt: Both numbers are negative. Where is the point?

feedback.wrong_option: Negative x is left and negative y is down.

screens.correctMessage: Both negative means the lower left.

screens.prompt: A point with y = 0 sits where?

feedback.wrong_option: y = 0 means no step up or down, so the point is on the x axis.

screens.correctMessage: A zero coordinate puts the point on an axis, not in a quadrant.

lessons.whyItMatters: Signs tell a model which direction a value points.
